description: Drinking Water Stations FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. Europe’s first contactless bottle filling stations are being rolled out in the Fingal area by a local company Ecofil for Fingal County Council. The new bottle filling stations provide contactless, clean and safe water without the risk of touching high-use buttons that could increase the spread of infection. Coverage: Fingal County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Fingal County Council. Its tags are Drinking Water, Health, Parks, Parks Gardens and Open Spaces, Parks Open Spaces. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
